## Summary

I investigated ticket T-6006 by examining the pod logs and cluster state. The 3.9.0 deployment is stuck in Init:0/1 state because the vault-agent-init container is repeatedly failing with a 403 "permission denied" error when attempting to authenticate to Vault using the "orders-api" role. Since only the 3.9.0 pods fail while the 3.8.0 pods authenticate successfully, the issue lies with Vault's configuration rather than the Kubernetes cluster itself. I escalated the ticket to engineering to coordinate with the security team who manages Vault's role policies and can access its audit logs to determine why the role is now denying access to the new pods.
